IMPORTANT:

Review ONLY the selected text or the text pasted in the chat.

DO NOT:
- read other files
- search the workspace
- open reports
- inspect repositories
- inspect folders
- inspect PDFs
- inspect PPTX files

If additional context is required, stop and ask for it.

Output:
- Short summary
- Key issues
- Recommended changes
